messages:
maya: Heads-up — ran a backfill + surge sim for the new ProPlus tier changes landing next month. Results worry me for EU-west. TL;DR: 18% peak GPU-hour increase, 2x network egress at 95th percentile. Need ops plan.

jorge: Can you paste the sim command and baseline numbers? :eyes:

maya: Sure, command:
```
./sim-capacity --scenario=proplus_tier-reprice --days=14 --region=eu-west --requests-per-day=1.2e6
```
Baseline peak GPU-hrs/day: 2300 -> projected peak: 2714 (+414)
95th pctl network egress: 6.2TB -> 12.4TB (due to higher embedding churn)

sam: Oof. 414 GPU-hrs/day is ~17-18% as you said. On our current node sizes that's ~13 additional A100s sustained during peak. EU quota is tight, we have only 48 spare A100 slots.

li: KV cache hit-rate in sim dropped from 72% -> 61% because more small calls from ProPlus customers. That increases tokens served + causes more prefix rebuilding.

callum: I ran a backfill sim with reserve pool enabled, results:
```
reserve_pool = 40 GPUs
burst_buckets = 6
expected_unserved_pct = 0.9%
```
It keeps SLA but increases cost by ~$32k/month.

finance-bot: Quick calc: +414 gpu-hrs/day * 30 days = 12,420 gpu-hrs/month. At average unit cost $2.6/hr => ~$32,292/month additional infra spend.

maya: Options we should evaluate: 1) increase EU reserved capacity (procure 20 GPUs) 2) tighten rate limits for ProPlus 3) promote caching + batching in SDK (product) 4) soft quota with graceful degradation to smaller model family.

jorge: Also check networking corridor: 10Gbps links on some racks are already at 75% on peaks. If we add GPUs without fixing egress we'll just bottleneck.

li: Quick mitigation that helps right away: enable sticky model routing for ProPlus so hot prefixes stay on same host, should recover ~6% hit-rate.

sam: Action items:
- jorge: run rack egress survey and list candidate racks (ETA EOD)
- callum: price 20-GPU reserved procurement + timeline (ETA tomorrow)
- eng-ml (cc @li): prototype sticky routing toggle on canary (ETA 3d)
- product: consider soft rate cap for ProPlus early adopters (will ping)

maya: Thanks — will post a brief for execs once we have procurement numbers. :thumbsup:

autoscale-bot: Detected new thread tag 'capacity-sim'. Suggested autoscale policy patch:
```
min_gpus_region[euw] = current_min + 10
burst_ratio = 1.25
prefetch_cache_ttl = 600
```
Recommendation: manual approve.

callum: Approved for procurement estimate, started RFQ with cloud partner.

jorge: EOD update: 4 racks at euw-1 show >=80% egress. Sending list.

maya: Great, thanks everyone. Will sync tomorrow 10am.
